scope: Bounded authored development research. Preserved failed attempts and post-hoc challenges; no neural superiority or generalization qualification.
compression: gzip streams have deterministic mtime=0; payload hashes refer to decompressed bytes.
normalization: Artifact JSON and frozen source snapshots are byte-identical to retained originals. Archived experiment scripts replace local filesystem paths only; their original and published payload hashes are distinct where normalized. Scripts are forensic records, not a portable full-study rerun entrypoint.
